title: Cross-Cloud Caching for External Connections
summary: BigQuery Connection now supports configuring cross-cloud caching for AWS, Azure, and Salesforce Data Cloud connections, potentially boosting query performance and reducing egress costs.
details: A new `CrossCloudCacheOptions` schema has been introduced, containing an `enabled` boolean field. This option is now available as `crossCloudCacheOptions` within the `AwsProperties`, `AzureProperties`, and `SalesforceDataCloudProperties` schemas. Developers can use this to enable or disable caching of data and metadata files for cross-cloud queries, which can improve performance and decrease network egress costs.
